probe_text: This is a ground finch. A seed-eater — the same unremarkable little bird Darwin watched cracking seeds on these islands, two centuries ago. It has no business wanting blood at all. So how did a seed-eater learn to drink blood — and why does a seabird twenty times its size simply let it happen?
